meta.description: stationcomplete: complete railway station data in OpenStreetMap.

intro.title: Complete the data of your station
intro.text: Platform numbers, track numbers, stop markers: in a few minutes on the platform, you make this information useful to everyone, from travel apps to railway tools such as OSRD.

safety.title: Stay behind the safety line.
safety.text: Everything is done from the platform, or from home thanks to the aerial photo. Never step down onto the tracks and never go beyond the end of the platform.

osm.title: Your contributions go to OpenStreetMap
osm.text: The free, collaborative map. They are published under your OSM username, under the ODbL licence, and nothing is uploaded until you have reviewed it.

explore.title: Explore stations in France
explore.text: See right now what is missing in each station: platform numbers, track numbers, stop markers. Editing and uploading to OpenStreetMap are coming soon.

lang.title: Choose your language
lang.text: Suggested from your phone settings, without location.
lang.later: You can change this at any time in Settings.

project.title: The project
project.text: stationcomplete helps everyone complete the data of French railway stations in <osm>OpenStreetMap</osm>: platform numbers, track numbers and train stop markers. This open data serves everyone, in particular railway design tools such as <osrd>OSRD</osrd>.

safety.title: Safety
safety.text: Always stay behind the safety line. Everything is done from the platform or remotely, on the aerial photo. Never step down onto the tracks.

data.title: Data and licences
data.osm: Contributions are published in OpenStreetMap under your username, under the <odbl>ODbL</odbl> licence. © OpenStreetMap contributors.
data.code: The stationcomplete code is free software, under the GPL-3.0-or-later licence: see the source code.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.text: This site sets no cookies and uses no audience measurement tool. Your edits stay on your phone until they are uploaded to OpenStreetMap.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: A mistake, an idea, a station that causes problems? Write to <mail>{email}</mail> or open an issue on <issues>GitHub</issues>.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.text: stationcomplete.org is a volunteer, non-commercial project published by Loïc Hamelin, a private individual, who is also the director of publication.

host.title: Hosting
host.text: GitHub Pages — GitHub, Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, United States.

content.title: Content and licences
content.osm: Map data: © OpenStreetMap contributors, under the <odbl>ODbL</odbl> licence.
content.code: App code: GPL-3.0-or-later licence, source code on GitHub.
content.independent: stationcomplete is a personal project: it is not a service of SNCF or of the OpenStreetMap Foundation.

data.title: Personal data — stationcomplete
data.lead: stationcomplete has no server of its own: it receives, stores and sells no data about you. This page explains what happens on your phone and with the services the app contacts.

phone.title: On your phone
phone.storage: The stations you have viewed, your edits not yet uploaded, your settings and the downloaded aerial photos stay in your phone's browser storage.
phone.position: Your location is only used to check, on the phone, that you really are at the station. It is sent to no one.
phone.login: If you log in, the OpenStreetMap login key and your username are kept on the phone. Your password is never seen by stationcomplete: you enter it on the OpenStreetMap website.
phone.nothing: No cookies, no advertising, no audience measurement.

publish.title: What you publish on OpenStreetMap
publish.text: When you upload your edits, they are published on OpenStreetMap under your username, with the date and the description of the upload. Like any contribution to OpenStreetMap, they are public and remain in the map history. This data is managed by the OpenStreetMap Foundation, according to its <policy>privacy policy</policy>.

services.title: Services contacted by your phone
services.lead: As with any website, these services see the IP address of your connection:
services.github: GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., United States): hosting of the app. GitHub privacy statement.
services.osm: OpenStreetMap (OpenStreetMap Foundation, United Kingdom): reading station data, logging in and uploading contributions.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can delete at any time everything stationcomplete keeps on this phone. For your published contributions and your OpenStreetMap account, contact the OpenStreetMap Foundation. For any question: <mail>{email}</mail>. You can also lodge a complaint with the <cnil>CNIL</cnil> (French data protection authority).
